Frog Quirk.name: Frog Quirk
Frog Quirk.description:
🐸 You have frog legs, wall grip, quick swimming and a long tongue.

🌱 At the start you lift one adult with your tongue up to twenty meters away, hop several meters, cling to walls, make mild irritant mucus and rinse your stomach.
📈 With training: tongue throws, water rescues, mucus scent masking, skin camouflage with gear visible, tongue work while climbing or leaping.
⚠️ You need warmth and held breath underwater; cold brings hibernation, weak walls defeat your grip, and your tongue can be injured or overloaded.
🔗 Canon Drawback, built in: Activation Condition, as cold slows your body into hibernation.
🎬 Canon Quirk: Tsuyu Asui's Frog. You are not related to her; people who know her Quirk notice the resemblance.

📈 Grants: Cooperativeness +1, Quirk Mobility +10, Quirk Control +10, Swimming +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Tongue Wrist Loop, Low Bank Hop
Frog Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects:
Scale: strong legs, wall grip, swimming, 20 m tongue. Start: tongue-lift one adult, hop several meters, cling to walls, eject and rinse own stomach, ooze mild irritant mucus. Camouflage, scent masking need training.
Limits: tongue is flesh: cuts, burns, bites, grabs hurt; loads within muscle strength; pulls need an anchor. Crumbling walls fail; holds breath underwater. Long cold brings hibernation until warmed. Mucus is no sure knockout; camouflage is not silent, hides no carried people.
Quirk Strain: light: wrist loop, short hop; moderate: throw, climbing search, water tow, mucus coat; heavy: long camouflage; severe: full tongue sweep, loaded high leap, long rescue combos.
Drawback: built in, the canon Activation Condition.
Canon: Tsuyu Asui's Quirk; user is unrelated, no tie unless the story makes one; those who know it see the resemblance.
Type: Mutant.
Law: public capture and combat need a license; unlawful restraint or mucus-coating is assault.
Look: frog eyes.
